title: Billboard-as-a-service scarce digital property
hypothesis: People will pay for a scarce, visible digital placement when ownership, scarcity, permanence, or attention is clearly packaged.
buyer: Creators, collectors, small businesses and communities seeking a persistent digital placement
offer: Buy a defined scarce placement with a clear term, location, and proof of ownership/use.
smallest_test: Publish one tightly defined scarce placement and solicit 10 qualified prospects.
